2608.23400.title: Adaptive Item-based Collaborative Structures via Noise Rescheduling in Diffusion for Generative Recommendation
2608.23400.paper_summary: Discrete Diffusion Models (DDMs) have recently been introduced to recommendation systems, modeling user history as a token generation process via iterative denoising. However, while effective at capturing user-level sequential patterns, these methods often fail to explicitly integrate item-based collaborative filtering information, a critical component for accurate recommendation. This deficiency manifests in two key aspects: (1) the item representation is often semantic-focused, lacking collaborative priors for diffusion training; and (2) the denoising process employs a uniform noise schedule, treating all tokens indiscriminately and ignoring item-level adaptive structural dependencies. To bridge this gap, we propose ANR-DiffRec, a unified framework designed to encode item-based collaborative structures into discrete diffusion for generative recommendation. First, we explicitly incorporate an item co-occurrence matrix to guide semantic ID generation, providing a structured collaborative prior for discrete diffusion training. Second, we introduce an item-based adaptive noise rescheduling mechanism that dynamically adjusts denoising weights according to both local contextual recoverability and behavior-aware item dependencies. Specifically, the proposed strategy jointly models intra-item structural context and inter-item collaborative signals, enabling structure-aware denoising during diffusion training. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art generative recommendation models. Code: https://github.com/CalmaQi/ANR-DiffRec.
2608.23400.paper_summary_zh: 離散擴散模型（DDMs）最近被引入到推薦系統中，將用戶歷史建模為通過迭代去噪的標記生成過程。<lb/>然而，雖然這些方法在捕捉用戶級別的序列模式方面有效，但它們往往未能明確整合基於項目的協同過濾信息，這是準確推薦的關鍵組成部分。<lb/>這一缺陷表現在兩個主要方面：（1）項目表示通常側重於語義，缺乏擴散訓練的協同先驗；（2）去噪過程採用均勻的噪聲計劃，無差別地對待所有標記，忽略了項目級別的自適應結構依賴性。<lb/>為了彌補這一差距，我們提出了ANR-DiffRec，一個統一框架，旨在將基於項目的協同結構編碼到離散擴散中，以實現生成推薦。<lb/>首先，我們明確地納入了一個項目共現矩陣，以指導語義ID生成，為離散擴散訓練提供結構化的協同先驗。<lb/>其次，我們引入了一種基於項目的自適應噪聲重新調度機制，根據局部上下文可恢復性和行為感知的項目依賴性動態調整去噪權重。<lb/>具體而言，所提出的策略共同建模項內結構上下文和項間協同信號，使得在擴散訓練過程中能夠進行結構感知的去噪。<lb/>在多個基準上的廣泛實驗表明，我們的方法始終優於最先進的生成推薦模型。<lb/>代碼：https://github.com/CalmaQi/ANR-DiffRec。
